decisions.statement: A request naming no challenge of the right shape is refused before anybody signs in.
A reader signed in nowhere is sent to the sign-in page and comes back here.
The challenge is carried through the sign-in and back onto the code minted here.
The code is handed to the app over its url scheme rather than to a browser.
The code names the app's bundle id and no origin.

definition: the code the iOS app takes away from a sign-in made in the system browser
